senses.definition: Any form of transport that can be used by a member of public (who usually pays a fare); as opposed to private ownership of e.g. cars.
senses.example: Nevertheless, China’s investment in subway systems is overwhelmingly positive. And there are also encouraging signs, too, that Chinese cities are beginning to shape urban development around public transport hubs. For example, Tiantongyuan, a high-density community of giant housing blocks in the suburbs of northern Beijing, has three subway stations.
